svg.title: Proxy, implementation and ProxyAdmin
svg.desc: Users call the fixed UBOX proxy 0xc3F20D5488784D922aC3428a54125715fA98db04. The proxy keeps balances and other storage and runs the current implementation V3 via delegatecall; V1 and V2 code remains but is no longer used; V4 is local only. ProxyAdmin, owned by account A, can call upgradeAndCall to switch implementations.

svg.text: Same front door (address), swappable back office (code)
